facts.title: Savory Mashed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 4 pounds sweet potatoes (about 7 small-to-medium), peeled and cut into 1″ cubes
⅓ cup finely sliced green onion, mostly green parts (from 1 bunch)
⅓ cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
1 small-to-medium garlic clove, pressed or minced
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
